normalization.materials: omitted; neutral side materials assigned by renderer
normalization.normals: original glTF normals imported by Blender, inverse-transpose transformed, coordinate-mapped, and unit-normalized
normalization.piece_local_origin: transformed horizontal bounding-box centre at x=z=0; transformed base at y=0
normalization.source_up_axis: Y_UP (glTF), imported by Blender into Z_UP
normalization.vertex_deduplication: source vertex index plus exact transformed preserved corner normal
